claims.assertion: Urmah honor ancestors and consult feline guides, a “cosmic cat” concept not necessarily a deity; all things are conscious Source fragments.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, relaying Urmah beliefs

claims.assertion: Urmah ethics link selfhood with all beings: they value a strong, healthy ego, respect and helping others while preserving their own resources.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, relaying Ari’s explanation
claims.qualifiers: Mari says this is an established cultural principle.

claims.assertion: Urmah view enemies as parts of themselves and may use force as spiritual cleansing when they judge other options exhausted, then feel ethically at peace.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, describing Urmah beliefs
claims.qualifiers: This describes their stated ethical framework.

coverage_gaps: cultivated meat and ritual treatment of hunted animals omitted
